profile_text.body:
Gamma is a web-based design tool that the company describes as an all-in-one AI-powered design partner for creating presentations, websites, documents, and social media assets, with no coding or design experience required. Its core product, also called Gamma, falls in the presentations and slides category and centers on AI-assisted generation that the company says allows users to instantly mock up and visualize ideas.

Gamma offers a free tier with a starter pack of AI credits, and paid plans unlock access to newer AI models, additional credits, advanced analytics, custom fonts, and the option to remove the Gamma badge. Users on free individual plans have their content included in AI training by default, though they can opt out through account settings at any time, while Team and Business workspace content is automatically excluded from AI training.

The site's held facts confirm Gamma maintains an active profile on theworldofai.org, verified as of August 2026, with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence noted in the available data.
